parameters.query:
=SELECT
    p.sku,
    p.name,
    p.category,
    p.color,
    p.movement,
    p.material,
    p.water_resistance_m,
    p.warranty_months,
    p.active_discount_percent,
    p.price_inr,
    p.price_aed,
    COALESCE(i.stock, 0) AS stock
FROM workspace.agentic_support.products p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sku, SUM(stock_quantity) AS stock
    FROM workspace.agentic_support.inventory
    GROUP BY sku
) i ON i.sku = p.sku
WHERE LOWER(p.sku) = LOWER('{{ $json.product_a }}')
   OR LOWER(p.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER('{{ $json.product_a }}'), '%')
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(p.sku) = LOWER('{{ $json.product_a }}')
          OR LOWER(p.name) = LOWER('{{ $json.product_a }}')
        THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END,
    p.name
LIMIT 5
